mapper.select: SELECT tc.clean_id, clean_name, regist_date, mt.type_code, mt.type_name, COUNT(tm.memo_id) memo_cnt FROM t_clean tc INNER JOIN m_type mt ON tc.type_code = mt.type_code LEFT OUTER JOIN t_memo tm ON tc.clean_id = tm.clean_id GROUP BY tc.clean_id, clean_name, regist_date, mt.type_code, mt.type_name ORDER BY tc.clean_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_clean ( clean_name, regist_date, type_code, remarks ) VALUES ( #{clean.cleanName}, #{clean.registDate}, #{clean.typeCode}, #{clean.remarks} )
